Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **formatBytes(n)** converts byte counts to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
- **slugify(title)** converts text to URL-friendly slugs with lowercase, dashes for spaces, and only alphanumeric+dash characters
- **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** fetches users from the API endpoint, logs the count, and returns the array
